elaine: Quick design call — small playground UX follow-ups for streaming chat. PTAL Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/playground-streaming (mock) matt: LGTM. main worry: stopping a stream should give explicit 'Stop and keep partial' vs 'Stop and roll back' — users expect to edit partial output. Can we show a small faded 'partial' label + eyeball icon? priyanka: Agreed. Also keyboard: when streaming, Esc should stop but focus stays on output so screen readers don't jump. ARIA-live needs `polite` only after stream completes? a11y-bot suggested `aria-live='assertive'` but that's noisy. a11y-bot: a11y-bot: Quick note: use aria-live='polite' for continuous updates, then set aria-atomic='false'. When stream ends set role='status' briefly to announce completion. sam: Token counter — microcopy: 'tokens' vs 'approx tokens' vs 'est. prompt tokens'... recommend 'tokens (est.)' with tooltip showing breakdown: prompt / completion / cached. Also add tooltip copy for 3rd-party models. jules: For regenerate: if user hits regenerate while streaming, we should cancel current stream and start new request. UX: replace 'Stop' button with 'Cancel & Regenerate' momentarily? Might be confusing. matt: What about a 'hold' state: user clicks Stop -> UI shows 'Paused (edit or resume)' with 'Resume stream' and 'Regenerate' options. I like paused state. elaine: Design ask: mockups for paused state and token tooltip. Also prompt library — search should show fuzzy matches and token cost estimate per saved prompt. Small list of items: 1) paused state microcopy 2) token tooltip copy 3) keyboard shortcuts 4) prompt library token column 5) aria tweaks. priyanka: Copy suggestions: paused CTA: 'Resume response' and secondary 'Regenerate with same prompt'. Token tooltip: 'Estimated token usage. May vary by model and cached prefixes.' sam: Also add an option in settings: 'compact streaming' to collapse partial tokens so long streams don't push view. matt: Dev note: backend sends `partial=true/false` in SSE — we can toggle aria-live based on that. Need small SDK change. deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploys for playground UI changes on channel `playground-ui` at 2024-05-03T16:00Z elaine: Ok next steps: Prio to paused state + token tooltip. @priyanka @matt can you pair on copy + dev constraints? I'll update figma and post new artboards. priyanka: :thumbsup: will do. I'll draft copy and post before EOD. matt: I'll add the SDK flag and a tiny test harness. ETA tomorrow. jules: I'll run quick a11y pass once copy + mockups are up. sam: Quick nit: token counter should show '0 cached' if nothing cached (avoid negative impression). elaine: Thanks all. small follow-ups: add keyboard doc snippet to docs: `Esc = stop`, `Ctrl+Enter = regenerate`. ``` matt: Agree. I'll wire it. priyanka: Posted copy draft: https://docs.google.com/xxx — comments welcome. elaine: Closing thread — will ping when figma is updated.
